map.输入皮革染料穿透深度和染色参数，评估染色质量等级: Enter the dye penetration depth and dyeing parameters to evaluate the dyeing quality grade
map.📖 查看「染色（染料穿透度）评估 使用指南」: 📖 Read the Dyeing (Dye Penetration) Evaluation user guide
map.染料穿透率 = 穿透深度 ÷ 皮革厚度 × 100%；穿透率不低于 80% 为完: Dye penetration rate = penetration depth ÷ leather thickness × 100%; a penetration rate of at least 80% counts as full penetration (excellent), 50% to 79% as partial penetration (good), and below 50% as surface dyeing (poor); evenness and color fastness are each scored 0 to 5; the overall score = penetration score × 40% + evenness × 30% + color fastness × 30%; an overall score of at least 85 is grade A, 70 to 84 is grade B, 60 to 69 is grade C, and below 60 fails and must be reworked; cowhide is thicker and often needs longer dyeing time or higher temperature to raise the penetration rate.
map.按染料穿透深度与皮革厚度计算穿透率，结合均匀度与色牢度评定染色等级。: Compute the penetration rate from the dye penetration depth and the leather thickness, and grade the dyeing together with evenness and color fastness.
map.排查染色不透（表面浮色、切面白心）问题，调整染料浓度、温度或时间。: Troubleshoot incomplete penetration (surface floating color, white core on the cut face) by adjusting the dye concentration, temperature or time.
map.按 QB/T 4672 判定批次是否合格，控制出厂质量。: Judge whether a batch passes against QB/T 4672 to control outgoing quality.
map.穿透率(%) = 穿透深度 ÷ 厚度 × 100%。等级判定（三项须同时满足）：: Penetration rate (%) = penetration depth ÷ thickness × 100%. Grade rules (all three must be met): penetration ≥90% and evenness ≥8 and color fastness ≥ grade 4 → superior product; ≥70% and ≥6 and ≥3 → first-grade product; ≥50% and ≥5 and ≥3 → qualified product; otherwise it fails. Refer to QB/T 4672 for leather dyeing fastness testing.
map.厚 1.5 mm、穿透深度 1.35 mm：穿透率 = 1.35/1.5×100: Thickness 1.5 mm, penetration depth 1.35 mm: penetration = 1.35/1.5×100 = 90%; with evenness 8 and color fastness grade 4 → superior product. map.穿透率到 100% 一定最好吗？: Is a penetration rate of 100% always best?
map.大多数产品要求染透以避免切面白心，但某些特殊风格（如表面效应）并不追求全透；评级: Most products require full penetration to avoid a white core on the cut face, but some special styles (such as surface effects) do not aim for full penetration; grading also needs evenness and color fastness, so the penetration rate alone is not enough.
map.染色不透怎么处理？: What do I do when the dye does not penetrate?
map.可提高染料浓度、延长染色时间、适当升温，或使用匀染/渗透助剂；同时检查中和是否充: You can raise the dye concentration, extend the dyeing time, raise the temperature somewhat, or use leveling and penetration auxiliaries; at the same time check whether neutralization is sufficient and whether the fibers are too tight.
map.染料穿透深度反映染色渗透程度，优等品要求≥90%穿透率: Dye penetration depth reflects how far the dye has penetrated, and a superior product requires a penetration rate of at least 90%
map.色牢度按GB/T 250灰色样卡评级，最高5级: Color fastness is rated against the GB/T 250 gray scale, up to grade 5
map.染色均匀度受皮坯预处理和染色工艺影响: Dyeing evenness is affected by hide preparation and the dyeing process
map.提高穿透率可增加染料浓度、延长染色时间或提高温度: Raising the penetration rate means increasing dye concentration, extending dyeing time or raising temperature
map.色牢度不足可添加固色剂改善: Insufficient color fastness can be improved with a fixing agent
map.皮革染色质量评估工具，输入染料穿透深度、均匀度、色牢度等参数，按QB/T标准判定: A leather dyeing quality evaluation tool that takes parameters such as dye penetration depth, evenness and color fastness and grades the dyeing against the QB/T standard.
map.均匀度/色牢度综合评估: Combined evenness and color fastness evaluation
map.优等/一等/合格/不合格分级: Grading into superior / first-grade / qualified / fail
